chunks: Say: O People of the Book, do you resent us for no reason other than that we believed in Allah and in what was revealed to us and what was revealed before, and that most of you are disobedient?

key_terms.تَنْقِمُونَ: You resent / You bear a grudge

ai.seo_question: Why do the People of the Book resent the Muslims according to this verse?
ai.summary: In the context of the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah, this verse highlights the core grievance of the People of the Book: their resentment that Muslims adhered to divine revelation without compromising for political expediency. Shia exegesis often links this 'fasiqun' (disobient) characterization to the broader narrative of covenant-breaking, emphasizing that true piety lies in steadfast adherence to the message of Muhammad (PBUH) and his progeny.
